description: Central Province - Regulation imposed under the Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority Statutes No. 01 of 2000 and No. 04 of 1992
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a new regulation regarding passenger transport services, specifically ticket requirements and penalties. It references statutory authority (Passenger Transporting Statute No. 04 of 1992 and Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000) and creates new regulatory requirements and compliance rules. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the main purpose of establishing legal/regulatory framework rather than being primarily about government personnel or structure. The content fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates new binding rules under statutory authority.
